programme.desc: Hajime's party enters the Haltina Sea of Trees. Hajime suddenly restrains Yue, Tio and Ryutaro, who were replaced by mimics. While looking for the missing three, they encounter a goblin.

programme.title: Arifureta: From Commonplace to World's Strongest S3 Ep07
programme.desc: Having escaped the dream, Hajime concludes that the labyrinth is testing his party's bonds and mental resilience. At the deepest point of the labyrinth, the 'most fearful' existence awaits...

programme.desc: Affected by magic, Hajime and party's feelings towards their allies and enemies are reversed. However, Hajime and Yue's actions towards their enemy remain the same despite hating each other...

programme.title: Attack on Titan S2 Ep01
programme.desc: The shocking discovery inside the Walls causes a stir. Elsewhere, while the new Scout recruits are held for observation, a new threat appears.

programme.title: Attack on Titan S2 Ep02

programme.title: Attack on Titan S2 Ep03
programme.desc: The Recon Corps Scouts continue to search for the breach in Wall Rose. Elsewhere, Hanji's squad continues to escort the mysterious Pastor Nick in their journey towards Ehrmich.

programme.title: Raven of the Inner Palace Ep11
programme.desc: Jusetsu finds Setsu Gyoei and Koshun playing go when visiting the Spotted Nutcracker Temple. She plays a round with Koshun before chatting with him in the garden.

programme.title: Raven of the Inner Palace Ep12
programme.desc: Jusetsu heads to the Magpie Nest Palace and finds a haggard-looking Kin Keiyo. Believed to be bedridden after her brother's death, she was, in fact, spending her time at the Magpie Nest Palace.

programme.title: THE MARGINAL SERVICE Ep12
programme.desc: Brian meets Zeno at Mount Minakami and suggests saving the children together but is refused. Meanwhile, Earth is on the verge of destruction as the Grey Shock is about to happen again.

programme.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero S4 Ep01
programme.desc: Naofumi's party travels to Siltvelt, the only place to get a boat to Q'ten Lo. However, due to the people of Siltvelt's enthusiastic welcome, they are delayed.

programme.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero S4 Ep02
programme.desc: Werner has no intention of preparing the boat even as he provides Naofumi with a warm reception. Meanwhile, Ethan approaches Atla and Fohl and reveals the truth about their father's death.

programme.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero S4 Ep03
programme.desc: Siltvelt castle is rocked by an attempted poisoning at breakfast. The factions begin to argue as Atla snaps and lectures them about Naofumi's greatness. Naofumi exposes the culprit, but...

programme.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero S4 Ep04
programme.desc: Fohl battles the cunning Jaralis while Atla takes on the veteran warrior Lyceras. Despite facing formidable foes, they remain steadfast. But Fohl falls victim to Jaralis's poison attack?!

programme.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero S4 Ep05
programme.desc: Fohl transforms into a beast and fights Jaralis. Naofumi's party joins the fight, but Jaralis eats his men and turns into a monster. Naofumi asks Fohl if he is resolved to become stronger.

programme.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero S4 Ep06
programme.desc: Naofumi returns to Lurolona Village and chooses the members who will follow him to Q'ten Lo. Elhart decides to come along as well. They set sail safely, but are then attacked by enemy ships.

programme.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero S4 Ep07
programme.desc: In Q'ten Lo, the party learns that killing animals is forbidden and the people are heavily taxed. Later, Naofumi makes contact with revolutionaries who are dissatisfied with the emperor.

programme.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero S4 Ep08
programme.desc: Raluva suggests capturing the old capital, but the sealed orochi revives just as the army is about to head out. Naofumi uses his Sakura Sphere of Influence to end the battle quickly, but...

programme.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero S4 Ep09
programme.desc: Naofumi gains control of the old capital region by declaring Filo to be the 'bird god.' While waiting for reinforcements, Naofumi and S'yne visit the forge, when the lost girl Zodia appears.

programme.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero S4 Ep10
programme.desc: Raphtalia meets the shrine maiden of the water dragon, Shildina. Shildina proposes a truce, and promises to set up an opportunity for peace talks with the emperor under certain conditions.

programme.title: The Rising of the Shield Hero S4 Ep11

programme.desc: An alluring female fairy seeks love among mortals and finds it in a man who takes care of an orphanage.
